prompt_segments.script_segment: By Day 10, something scary happens. Your brain's Default Mode Network shifts. Because you have no real voices to process, you might actually start hearing phantom sounds in silence. By Day 20, your internal voice changes completely. Without outside words, your thoughts become pure images and raw feelings instead of sentences. Finally, by Day 30, your brain adapts, but social re-entry feels impossible. Could you last a full month in total silence? Let me know in the comments and subscribe for more mind experiments.
